description: Despite the name, this works for any private ask (by invitation or by application): one from post_ask, an open call or a pro ask, not only calls. Put people on the list of an ask after it is posted: ixo1 addresses, @handles of people with a page, and "link" once per single-use link to mint. Each link admits one new person, whoever opens it first. A pro ask takes only verified pros: find_pro suggests them. For an ask posted with post_ask, pass its number as collectionId. Answers with the links to hand out and what was written. Only the poster, or the agent they connected, can. Spends nothing.

collectionId.description: Or the number of the ask or call, for one posted elsewhere by the account you act for (post_ask prints it).

invite.description: ixo1 addresses, @handles of people with a page, "link" once per single-use link to mint, or "exclude:<ixo1…>" to turn an address away.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

note.description: A note to the people invited, and the first message in the pro's room: each of them reads it with their invitation, so put access details (a test account) here. You see it in call_invites; only the people invited see it.

slug.description: The call's name, as draft_call gave it (a call posted from this machine).

name: invite_to_call
title: Invite pros or people to an ask
